verses.original: אֶל־ חִכְּךָ֣ שֹׁפָ֔ר כַּנֶּ֖שֶׁר עַל־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יַ֚עַן עָבְר֣וּ בְרִיתִ֔י וְעַל־ תּוֹרָתִ֖י פָּשָֽׁעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- ḥik·kə·ḵā šō·p̄ār kan·ne·šer ‘al- bêṯ Yah·weh ya·‘an ‘ā·ḇə·rū ḇə·rî·ṯî wə·‘al- tō·w·rā·ṯî pā·šā·‘ū
verses.literal: Put the ram’s horn to your lips An eagle looms over the house of the LORD because the people have transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My law
verses.literalPt: PÕE a trombeta à tua boca. Ele virá como a águia contra a casa do SENHOR, porque transgrediram a minha aliança, e se rebelaram contra a minha lei.

verses.literal: Israel cries out to Me O our God we know You
verses.literalPt: E a mim clamarão: Deus meu! Nós, Israel, te conhecemos.

verses.literal: But Israel has rejected good an enemy will pursue him
verses.literalPt: Israel rejeitou o bem; o inimigo persegui-lo-á.

verses.original: הֵ֤ם הִמְלִיכוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מִמֶּ֔נִּי הֵשִׂ֖ירוּ וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתִּי כַּסְפָּ֣ם וּזְהָבָ֗ם עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן יִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: hêm him·lî·ḵū wə·lō mim·men·nî hê·śî·rū wə·lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî kas·pām ū·zə·hā·ḇām ‘ā·śū lā·hem ‘ă·ṣab·bîm lə·ma·‘an yik·kā·rêṯ
verses.literal: They set up kings but not by Me They make princes but without My approval With their silver and gold they make themselves idols to their own destruction
verses.literalPt: Eles fizeram reis, mas não por mim; constituíram príncipes, mas eu não o soube; da sua prata e do seu ouro fizeram ídolos para si, para serem destruídos.

verses.original: זָנַח֙ עֶגְלֵ֣ךְ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן חָרָ֥ה אַפִּ֖י בָּ֑ם עַד־ מָתַ֕י לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ נִקָּיֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: zā·naḥ ‘eḡ·lêḵ šō·mə·rō·wn ḥā·rāh ’ap·pî bām ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay lō yū·ḵə·lū niq·qā·yōn
verses.literal: He has rejected your calf O Samaria My anger burns against them How long will they be . . . incapable . . . of innocence
verses.literalPt: O teu bezerro, ó Samaria, te rejeitou; a minha ira se acendeu contra eles; até quando serão eles incapazes da inocência?

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְה֔וּא חָרָ֣שׁ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ שְׁבָבִ֣ים יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עֵ֖גֶל שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kî mî·yiś·rā·’êl wə·hū ḥā·rāš ‘ā·śā·hū wə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm hū kî- šə·ḇā·ḇîm yih·yeh ‘ê·ḡel šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: For this thing is from Israel a craftsman made it and it . . . is not God It will be broken to pieces that calf of Samaria
verses.literalPt: Porque isso vem de Israel, um artífice o fez, e não é Deus; mas em pedaços será desfeito o bezerro de Samaria.

verses.original: כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יִזְרָ֖עוּ וְסוּפָ֣תָה יִקְצֹ֑רוּ קָמָ֣ה אֵֽין־ ל֗וֹ צֶ֚מַח בְּלִ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂה־ קֶּ֔מַח אוּלַ֣י יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה זָרִ֖ים יִבְלָעֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî rū·aḥ yiz·rā·‘ū wə·sū·p̄ā·ṯāh yiq·ṣō·rū qā·māh ’ên- lōw ṣe·maḥ bə·lî ya·‘ă·śeh- qe·maḥ ’ū·lay ya·‘ă·śeh zā·rîm yiḇ·lā·‘u·hū
verses.literal: For they sow the wind and they shall reap the whirlwind There is no standing grain what sprouts fails to yield flour Even if it should produce the foreigners would swallow it up
verses.literalPt: Porque semearam vento, e segarão tormenta, não haverá seara, a erva não dará farinha; se a der, tragá-la-ão os estrangeiros.

verses.original: נִבְלַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַתָּה֙ הָי֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּכְלִ֖י אֵֽין־ חֵ֥פֶץ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·la‘ yiś·rā·’êl ‘at·tāh hā·yū ḇag·gō·w·yim kiḵ·lî ’ên- ḥê·p̄eṣ bōw
verses.literal: Israel is swallowed up Now they are among the nations like a worthless . . . vessel
verses.literalPt: Israel foi devorado; agora está entre os gentios como um vaso em que ninguém tem prazer.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ עָל֣וּ אַשּׁ֔וּר פֶּ֖רֶא בּוֹדֵ֣ד ל֑וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם הִתְנ֥וּ אֲהָבִֽים
verses.transliteration: kî- hêm·māh ‘ā·lū ’aš·šūr pe·re bō·w·ḏêḏ lōw ’ep̄·ra·yim hiṯ·nū ʾă·hå̄·ḇīm
verses.literal: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey on its own . . . Ephraim has hired lovers
verses.literalPt: Porque subiram à Assíria, como um jumento montês, por si só; Efraim mercou amores.

verses.original: גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־ יִתְנ֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וַיָּחֵ֣לּוּ מְּעָ֔ט מִמַּשָּׂ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ שָׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam kî- yiṯ·nū ḇag·gō·w·yim ‘at·tāh ’ă·qab·bə·ṣêm way·yā·ḥêl·lū mə·‘āṭ mim·maś·śā me·leḵ śā·rîm
verses.literal: Though . . . they hire allies among the nations I will now round them up and they will begin to diminish under the oppression of the king of princes
verses.literalPt: Todavia, ainda que eles merquem entre as nações, eu os congregarei; e serão um pouco afligidos por causa da carga do rei dos príncipes.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִרְבָּ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת לַחֲטֹ֑א הָיוּ־ ל֥וֹ מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לַחֲטֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hir·bāh ’ep̄·ra·yim miz·bə·ḥōṯ la·ḥă·ṭō hā·yū- lōw miz·bə·ḥō·wṯ la·ḥă·ṭō
verses.literal: Though Ephraim multiplied the altars for sin they became his altars for sinning
verses.literalPt: Porquanto Efraim multiplicou os altares para pecar; teve altares para pecar.

verses.original: אֶכְתּוֹב ל֔וֹ רִבּוֹ תּֽוֹרָתִ֑י כְּמוֹ־ זָ֖ר נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ʾɛḵ·tōḇ lōw rib·bō tō·w·rā·ṯî kə·mōw- zār neḥ·šā·ḇū
verses.literal: Though I wrote for them . . . the great things of My law they regarded them as something strange
verses.literalPt: Escrevi-lhe as grandezas da minha lei, porém essas são estimadas como coisa estranha.

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י הַבְהָבַ֗י יִזְבְּח֤וּ בָשָׂר֙ וַיֹּאכֵ֔לוּ יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָצָ֑ם עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֺנָם֙ וְיִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה מִצְרַ֥יִם יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ziḇ·ḥê haḇ·hā·ḇay yiz·bə·ḥū ḇā·śār way·yō·ḵê·lū Yah·weh lō rā·ṣām ‘at·tāh yiz·kōr ‘ă·wō·nām wə·yip̄·qōḏ ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯām hêm·māh miṣ·ra·yim yā·šū·ḇū
verses.literal: Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to Me and though they eat the meat the LORD does not accept them Now He will remember their iniquity and punish their sins They will return to Egypt
verses.literalPt: Quanto aos sacrifícios das minhas ofertas, sacrificam carne, e a comem, mas o SENHOR não as aceita; agora se lembrará da sua iniqüidade, e punirá os seus pecados; eles voltarão para o Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־ עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ הֵֽיכָל֔וֹת וִֽיהוּדָ֕ה הִרְבָּ֖ה עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻר֑וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·kaḥ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- ‘ō·śê·hū way·yi·ḇen hê·ḵā·lō·wṯ wî·hū·ḏāh hir·bāh ‘ā·rîm bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ wə·šil·laḥ·tî- ’êš bə·‘ā·rāw wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces Judah has multiplied its fortified cities But I will send fire upon their cities and it will consume their citadels
verses.literalPt: Porque Israel se esqueceu do seu Criador, e edificou templos, e Judá multiplicou cidades fortificadas. Mas eu enviarei um fogo contra as suas cidades, que consumirá os seus palácios.
